notes:
- Sort button instead of Group: sort by name, date modified, date created, type, size, status or image dimensions (click again to reverse), plus grouping and "Folders first" in the same menu
- Default sorting is now Name A–Z with natural number order (01, 02 … 10); Downloads stays newest first, grouped by day
- Each folder remembers its own sorting; "Reset folder views" in Settings clears it too
- Right-click menu now shows submenus from Windows programs (e.g. Google Drive, 7-Zip)
- Photos and videos opened from Wayfolder: the arrow keys in the Photos app go through the folder, in Wayfolder's order
- Drag a folder from the sidebar onto a tab to open it there, or onto the empty tab bar for a new tab
